scope.feature: Public Dispatch plunder schedule wrapper/event/result integration

recoveredPublicSchedule.validationOrder: the complete 1..200 row batch is validated before the per-row persistence loop
recoveredPublicSchedule.persistenceOrder: validated rows are persisted sequentially through the recovered store call
recoveredPublicSchedule.partialWriteSemantics: if an earlier row persists and a later running/terminal conflict makes the guarded upsert return no row, earlier writes remain persisted and the command fails
recoveredPublicSchedule.eventOrder: emitted after the full sequential persistence loop succeeds; not emitted on a later guarded-write failure
recoveredPublicSchedule.return: accumulated scheduled-row values returned by each successful store call
recoveredPublicSchedule.frontendConsumption: the recovered Map Data frontend ignores the command return value and refreshes map_plunder_jobs_list after success
recoveredPublicSchedule.randomizationOwnership: frontend wrapper owns maxRandomDelaySeconds/randomDelaySeconds and passes the resulting plunderAt; backend does not add randomness

serverIdentityRecovery.schedule: signed 64-bit integer-like serverId, predicate serverId > 0 only
serverIdentityRecovery.scheduleEvidence: public wrapper compares qword serverId to 0 and branches invalid on <=0; no 0x1869f/99999 comparison in the hash-locked function
serverIdentityRecovery.cancelEvidence: typed parser stores serverId in rdi, test rdi,rdi; jle invalid; no 0x1869f/99999 comparison in the hash-locked function
serverIdentityRecovery.persistence: Dispatch-only local scheduler keys were widened to long; ordinary Map Data and server-jump validation remain unchanged
serverIdentityRecovery.currentV19ExecutionBoundary: the current-v19 executor remains proven only for 1..99999; a persisted positive serverId outside that domain is terminalized as DISPATCH_PLUNDER_INVALID_TARGET before running/attempt increment/send

boundary: Public scheduling is now implemented and offline-tested, but no real schedule or Dispatch steal has been executed. Any live Dispatch plunder acceptance still requires explicit owner authorization and a suitable target.
